definitions.gloss: gradually; little by little; step by step
definitions.explanation: Happening slowly over time; progressing in small increments.

examples.japanese: {次第|しだい}に{慣|な}れてきた。
examples.english: I gradually got used to it.

examples.japanese: {空|そら}が{次第|しだい}に{暗|くら}くなった。
{次第|しだい}に{状況|じょうきょう}が{改善|かいぜん}した。

notes:
{次第|しだい}に means "gradually" or "progressively," describing change that occurs slowly over time.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- だんだん: gradually (casual, everyday)
- {徐々|じょじょ}に: gradually (formal, written)
- {少|すこ}しずつ: little by little (emphasis on small increments)
- {段階的|だんかいてき}に: step by step, in stages

NUANCE DIFFERENCES:
- {次第|しだい}に: neutral to formal; emphasizes continuous progression
- だんだん: casual; most common in spoken Japanese
- {徐々|じょじょ}に: formal/literary; often in written contexts

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {次第|しだい}に{慣|な}れる: to gradually get used to
- {次第|しだい}に{増|ふ}える: to gradually increase
- {次第|しだい}に{変|か}わる: to gradually change
- {次第|しだい}に{分|わ}かってくる: to gradually come to understand

REGISTER:
More formal than だんだん, appropriate for both spoken and written Japanese.
